sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: Open intelligence research, reporting, and the software that makes both usable by someone who cannot buy a terminal. The reasoning is published so you can audit it instead of trusting a black box.

sections.heading: The work
lines: WarHeatMap   live global conflict map, one page per event
Tuck         congressional trades and disclosure data, handed back
VoxTerrae    the door from the map to the room
AXIOM        autonomous community security, method published
Ka-Tet       six AI agents and one human holding a system upright
VibeMaestro  one conductor for a whole ecosystem of AI-native apps

sections.heading: House rules
lines: No login, no paywall, no ads, no tracking on the tools we ship.
The method is public even where the calibration is not.
A claim gets a source or it does not get published.
